verdict: ROAS holds above baseline, but purchase consistency needs attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered a 4.76x return on ad spend — above the 3.8–4.6x test-phase baseline — on $1,495 in spend generating $7,121 in revenue. However, purchases are arriving in uneven bursts: 7 of the last 14 days recorded zero purchases, and the most recent 3-day window shows just 1 purchase compared to 5 in the 3 days prior. Over half of your ad spend is concentrated in a single campaign, so we're actively working to diversify creative and reduce that dependency. Separately, your Google Business Profile actions dropped sharply this week, and we're addressing that to protect local visibility heading into the next period.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend over the last 28 days, above the test-phase baseline
revenue generated from Meta ads this period on $1,495 in spend
local actions (calls, directions, website clicks) from your Google Business Profile this period

watch_item.issue: Purchases are arriving inconsistently — feast-or-famine rather than a steady cadence — and the top campaign carries 57% of total ad spend, creating concentration risk.
watch_item.fix: Creative diversification is underway to reduce reliance on a single campaign, and we're monitoring purchase frequency daily to catch any further softening early.
